verified_in_run_supplier_items.actual_excerpt: For every $n\ge0$, the map $\operatorname{enc}_n:\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,\ldots,2^n-1\}$ of [[def-qc-ordered-bitstring-encoding]] is a bijection.

For a permutation $\sigma$ of the $n$ factor positions, the **wire permutation** $P_\sigma$ maps the product basis vector indexed by $(i_0,\ldots,i_{n-1})$ to the product basis vector whose output factor order is $(\sigma(0),\ldots,\sigma(n-1))$.
The elementary tensors of the factor bases, ordered lexicographically, form an orthonormal basis of the tensor register.
The map $P_\sigma$ that reorders the factors is a bijective linear isometry.
The **tensor map** $\bigotimes_{k<n}T_k$ is the unique linear map satisfying $ (\bigotimes_{k<n}T_k)(x_0\otimes\cdots\otimes x_{n-1})=T_0x_0\otimes\cdots\otimes T_{n-1}x_{n-1}$.
The inverse sequence applies $U_k^\dagger$ first, then $U_{k-1}^\dagger$, down to $U_1^\dagger$.
